launcher.notes: SESSION SAFETY - NO MORE RE-LOGIN LOOPS. The launcher used to adopt an older (or dead legacy) refresh token from the shared account file over its own fresh Microsoft session, which is why every restart ended with a re-login ask; the merge now only takes a session that is STRICTLY NEWER and stamps every rotation (sessionAt, honoured by the client too). A newer in-game session is adopted together with its live Minecraft token and stays launchable without a forced re-refresh. Legacy device-code tokens can never poison modern msmc sessions, and re-signing in replaces old uuid-less rows by name instead of duplicating them. Startup now syncs with the client BEFORE the silent refresh. Restart the launcher and accept the update prompt.

notes: Kinetrix Client 3.7.1 - FULLBRIGHT HUD FIX + LOW HEALTH ALERT + AUTOGG MINEMEN FIX + HUD EDITOR HOTKEY. FULLBRIGHT FIX: with Fullbright enabled, the fake Night Vision potion no longer shows up in the Potion Status HUD or in your inventory - the effect still works exactly the same, it is just invisible to every potion display now. NEW MODULE: Low Health Alert - pulses a red warning around the screen when your health is low (like other games/clients), eases out automatically when you regenerate; configure the trigger (hearts), opacity and pulse speed. AUTOGG MINEMEN FIX: Minemen's 'Match Results' end line now triggers AutoGG at ANY sensitivity, and the one-fire-per-game latch re-arms after 90s so chained practice matches in the same world each get their gg; a genuine 'last man standing' result right after connect is no longer swallowed; new 'Minemen' entry in the Servers scope. HUD EDITOR HOTKEY: the module menu key (Right Shift by default) now opens the HUD Editor first - toggling, resizing and dragging HUD modules is the fastest flow; the module menu stays one click away via the editor's center 'Open Mods' button. Launcher 2.8.2 users get this through the mod updater prompt.
